Acknowledgement
===============

This package should be cited with acknowledgement of the BSM2 and BSM2-GHG upstream sources.

BSM2 sources
-------------

Benchmark Simulation Model No. 2 (BSM2) Ulf Jeppsson and Christian Rosen, Lund University, Sweden, and the IWA Task Group on Benchmarking of Control Strategies for WWTPs. 2009/2011.

Benchmarking biological nutrient removal in wastewater treatment plants: influence of mathematical model assumptions. Xavier Flores-Alsina, Krist V. Gernaey and Ulf Jeppsson. 2012.

Balancing effluent quality, economic cost and greenhouse gas emissions during the evaluation of (plant-wide) control/operational strategies in WWTPs. Xavier Flores-Alsina, Krist V. Gernaey, Ulf Jeppsson, et al. 2014.


ASM2d-compatible BSM2 Python 
------------------------------

Python packaging and ASM2d-compatible BSM2 refactoring: Dr Taher Abunama.
